desc: PLAN-APPROVED, runnable=false untethered B0 milestone. Ticket 119 conditionally passed preferred dual-mode object 46237ade for bounded hardware validation; every post-prefix byte matches live-proven fallback 2371ee5d, while exact version/Rust pins remain a provenance requirement. Ticket 082 still needs the maintainer's macOS volume UUID, enrolled-object backup/hash, selected manifest, and action split. Then the maintainer enrolls and performs a no-host boot-picker cold boot; the agent only observes/records. B0 pass = panel Alpine/OpenRC default runlevel, watchdog, keyboard echo, no host payload. Separately start the host proxy before a DebugUSB reboot to test the five-second window; misclassification/failure triggers documented fallback and is not called B0 failure or silently accepted. Rig is healthy but requires normal preflight. Agent runs no kmutil/bputil. Procedure: evidence/2026-07-24-t6040-b0-enrolled-cold-boot-preflight.md. Maintainer reverted to an m1n1-only enrolled loader (1394c345), which boots to Running proxy. This ticket cannot pass until a loader shape exists that can actually load stage 2 (USB stage-2 route). The verified artifacts are retained and reusable: diet kernel Image-b0-diet (16.8 MiB raw, -67%, chainload-proven), initramfs-alpine-b0-nb2.cpio.xz (Norwegian no-mac keymap, verified 'loaded no-mac.bmap'), m1n1 v2 5e9dcfd3 (unconditional early-proxy window, verified firing at sip0=0), m1n1 v3 c59d5820 (+FB_CONSOLE_ALWAYS). REVIVED 2026-07-25 (claude): runnable again. m1n1-b0-diet-aligned.bin (f290833c) boots when enrolled — the earlier failures were purely 16 KiB size misalignment (ticket 129). Carries the diet kernel, the Norwegian no-mac keymap OpenRC root, and a forced fb console.
